text: - [P2] Revalidate the artifact when reusing its dispatch session — crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1377-1384. If a file or overlay changes after the first dispatch while the provider is still in use, a later dispatch for another call in the same artifact reuses the old source without calling `exact_source_for_procedure` again. Previously each direct dispatch checked the current artifact key and rejected a stale handle; the retained session instead combines old call ranges and syntax with current analyzer lookups, which can produce incorrect dispatch results. The same issue affects uncached call transfers through this session.
brief_text:
## Affected callers

- `WorkspaceAnalyzer::icfg_provider` constructs a provider on each invocation (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/workspace.rs:1816`); construction allocates a fresh outcome cache (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:598`), while the provider's derived `Clone` shares the `Arc` containing the new dispatch-session map (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:504`).
- `SnapshotReplayProvider` delegates direct dispatch and call transfers to its borrowed underlying provider (`crates/bifrost-flow/src/dataflow/snapshot_replay.rs:37`, `crates/bifrost-flow/src/dataflow/snapshot_replay.rs:51`), reaching the retained-session routes when that provider is `WorkspaceIcfgProvider` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1377`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1477`).
- The summary solver calls `call_transfers`, canonicalizes the returned set, validates available transfers, and stores the outcome in its own cache keyed by the call handle (`crates/bifrost-flow/src/dataflow/summary.rs:1250`, `crates/bifrost-flow/src/dataflow/summary.rs:1267`); the workspace implementation now resolves uncached transfers through the artifact session (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1496`).
- Typestate dependency discovery iterates each procedure's call sites using one supplied request and invokes `call_transfers` for each (`crates/bifrost-flow/src/typestate/production.rs:1147`); distinct calls in the same artifact reach the same session lookup (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1477`).
- `WorkspaceSemanticOracle` also implements `DispatchOracle`, but creates a fresh prepared session for each direct call (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:1468`); it uses the same session constructor newly exposed to the ICFG provider (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:435`).

## Paths

- Direct ICFG dispatch acquires the artifact session before invoking its resolver (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1377`); the prepared resolver checks cancellation before checking artifact identity or accessing exact source (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:186`).
- Snapshot traversal calls `call_transfers` at invoke events below the call-depth limit and retains each answer in a snapshot-local transfer cache (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1855`); a provider-level completed-outcome hit returns before the new session acquisition (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1466`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1477`).
- Transfer projection holds the session guard until scalar-budget publication (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1478`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1735`). During that interval it consults the active model for external boundaries and reads candidate procedure properties (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1520`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1545`).
- The projection-charge helper returns a payload-free `Cancelled` or `ExceededBudget` outcome when its charge is rejected (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1999`); the new enclosing branch discards syntax acquired by this transfer before returning that outcome (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1715`).

## Value flow

- `ProcedureHandle::artifact` supplies the owning `Arc` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/ir/artifact.rs:1384`); the new session key compares and hashes its allocation address (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:524`). Procedure-handle equality independently uses the same allocation identity plus procedure ID (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/ir/artifact.rs:1487`).
- Each session-map insertion clones the provider's oracle and retains the supplied artifact (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:623`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:439`). Exact source later comes from `current_artifact_source`, with workspace-mount and artifact-key comparisons before returning the source (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:2607`).
- Dispatch outcomes from the session still feed read attribution (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1506`); attributed keys enter the analyzer read ledger, and unattributed results mark an unattributed read (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:681`). Completed transfer replay records the stored attribution without resolving dispatch again (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1466`).
- The session resolves against a cloned scalar budget (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1496`); `SemanticRequest::staged` preserves cancellation, the execution ledger, and the artifact collector (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/provider.rs:919`). The outer scalar budget receives the staged budget only when the final outcome has an available value (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/icfg.rs:1730`).
- `retains_exact_source` reads `low_level_source_paid`, and `discard_exact_source` clears both that flag and the low-level session (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:172`). Ordinary dispatch sets the flag from committed source-byte work (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:262`); the declared-local-target route sets it after charging source and result work (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:386`).

verification.summary: Reusing a dispatch session freezes the caller source rather than revalidating it per call.
verification.evidence: This is an explicit prepared-session contract at intro, not an accidental omission: crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:147-152 documents reuse of the exact source snapshot, and :5028-5102 tests overlay mutation after the first call, requires the retained session to keep its frozen second-call answer, and requires a fresh session to reject the stale artifact. The comment at :5075-5078 explicitly states that downstream declarations are not frozen. icfg.rs:610-629 deliberately extends that session to the query-local provider. Later cc37465b1bfc402e974694084dc1b1e8d1479e24 restores one-shot direct dispatch for transaction ownership reasons while retaining session reuse for transfers/snapshots; it does not establish a per-call revalidation requirement for retained sessions.

text: - [P2] Preserve current line endings for structural facts — crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3383-3385. When indexed source uses LF and the working file uses CRLF, this returns the indexed text where the previous code returned the compatible working text. Structural fact extraction uses this source, so its byte ranges after the first line no longer point to the corresponding positions in the working file.
brief_text:
## Affected callers
- `search_symbol_display_range` calls `DeclarationNameRangeContext::name_range`, which reaches the changed `location_ranges` call. It converts name lines to one-based lines (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/navigation.rs:2527`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/declaration_range.rs:101`).
- `external_usage_definition_ranges` also reaches that helper for classes and selected JavaScript fields. It supplies `indexed_source` and otherwise returns ordinary ranges (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:3113`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:3129`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/declaration_range.rs:101`).
- `EmptyAnalyzer` inherits the new location defaults. Its `declarations` implementation returns an empty set (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/workspace.rs:68`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:810`).
- `structural_facts_with_outcome` uses the changed `file_source` result for its snapshot key, cache lookup, and fact extraction (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/structural/provider.rs:411`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3382`).
- C++ namespace reconciliation uses `file_source` to populate its per-file namespace cache (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/cpp/mod.rs:369`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3382`).
- Summary construction still calls ordinary `declarations` and `ranges`, through `summary_root_units` and `summary_root_order` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:1289`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:1309`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:8070`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:8281`).

## Paths
- `MultiAnalyzer` routes both new location methods through file-language selection. Range routing uses `code_unit.source()`; an absent delegate gives an empty collection (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:303`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:315`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:621`).
- `indexed_source` reaches the changed `file_source` chain. That chain tries retained state, indexed hydration, current-source hydration, then a direct project read (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:7916`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3382`).
- The new current-source helper reaches `fetch_file_state_for_key_with_source`. During a streaming read, that function returns `streaming_file_state` before its exact-source hydration branch (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3768`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3820`).
- The target request loop calls `resolve_scan_usages_target`, which reaches the new location methods. It stores resolved overloads with `location_selected: true` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1949`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1960`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1368`).

## Value flow
- The changed declaration-name helper sorts and deduplicates location ranges. It passes each range to AST name selection, including line-span selection (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/declaration_range.rs:101`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/declaration_range.rs:128`).
- Location projections read current source through `current_source`. During a query, that function caches both text and `None` by `ProjectFile` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3742`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3721`).
- `structural_file_state` compares indexed and current text after CRLF normalization. It retains indexed state for other text differences; otherwise, it requests current-source state (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3747`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3773`).
- The new current-source helper passes text to `fetch_file_state_from_source`. That function hashes the bytes; the cache key combines this hash with the relative path (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3768`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3763`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3390`).
- Current-source hydration supplies exact text to the store. The hydration path assigns it to `state.source` and caches the resulting `Arc<FileState>` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3765`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3855`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3882`).
- Location selection derives its byte position from `indexed_source`. Module selectors compare that position with the new location ranges; other selectors compare name ranges (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1192`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1233`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1367`).
- `declarations_in_file` uses the new location declarations as traversal roots. It then adds same-file members through ordinary `get_members_in_class` calls (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1572`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1578`).

verification.summary: Structural facts intentionally use the indexed source and matching indexed coordinates rather than raw working-file bytes.
verification.evidence: At intro, crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/i_analyzer.rs:419-424 defines indexed_source as the source retained by the generation producing declarations and ranges. tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3382-3388 selects that source; indexed_source delegates to it at 7916-7917, and ordinary ranges select indexed state at 8281-8289. StructuralSearchProvider::structural_source uses the same file_source (structural/provider.rs:349-350); fact extraction, snapshot decoding and cache materialization all receive that same source at 411-427. Rendering declaration coordinates also reads indexed_source (structural/search/mod.rs:977-985). Thus the fact offsets are paired with their actual source, not incorrectly applied to CRLF working-file bytes by this path. Keeping ordinary traversal on indexed state is the explicit purpose of intro (commit message: isolate exact source recovery to location queries), and the findings identify no consumer requiring raw working-file offsets. Source-aware location APIs are a separate path and have the confirmed mismatch in the next group.

text: - [P2] Keep structural facts aligned with CRLF source — crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:3383-3385. When Git stores LF text but the working file uses CRLF, this returns the indexed LF text. Previously, `structural_file_state` selected the current CRLF text. Structural fact extraction therefore produces byte offsets that do not match the working file, so consumers can identify the wrong source span.

text: - [P2] Preserve distinct property gaps with the same reason and frontier — crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:142-142. When a definition has property gaps that share a reason and frontier but differ in kind or source site, lowering treats them as distinct rows, while this unique index collapses those distinctions and rejects the second row. Include the remaining gap identity fields so all valid lowered gaps can be projected.
brief_text:
## Affected callers
- `open_selected_resolution_mount_inventory_with_content_mounts` executes the assembled TEMP schema on its checked-out reader connection (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:1867); that assembly now includes `resolution_stage::schema_sql()` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:135).
- `SelectedResolutionMountInventory::drop` invokes full selection cleanup when the retained stamp differs or cannot be read (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:1670); that cleanup now deletes stage nodes after producers (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:142).
- `SelectedResolutionStage::clear_facts` executes `CLEAR_STAGE_SQL` through `with_owned_temp_write` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage.rs:108); the statement now deletes producers and nodes (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage.rs:88), and the wrapper accounts changes in `committed_request_changes` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:1352).
- Inventory destruction conditionally executes `CLEAR_REQUEST_SQL` before returning a retained selection to the connection (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:1651); this statement deletes stage nodes and admissions as well as producers (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage.rs:89).

## Paths
- The retained-selection route returns an inventory after checking routing and currentness (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:1816), before the schema-execution route (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:1867) that includes the new stage schema (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:135).
- Schema execution and initial clearing each return SQL errors from inventory opening after requesting connection cleanup (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:1867); both use the selection cleanup statement containing the new node deletion (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:142).
- Capsule admission inserts a producer and passes its rowid to `project` inside a transaction (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage.rs:176); generated typed tables reference that producer with `ON DELETE CASCADE` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:333). The transaction wrapper commits or rolls back according to the returned outcome (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_selection.rs:1381).

## Value flow
- `SemanticId::shared_name` encodes a shared identity and `shared_name_id` extracts its name ID (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/model.rs:460); the new semantic column generator represents runtime keys and shared IDs in separate nullable columns (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:7).
- `LoweredTypedFrontier` holds an optional `(SemanticId, BindingNodeId)` observation (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/typed_fact_lowering.rs:147); `type_frontiers` represents that pair separately from its slot (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:28). Lowered-fact validation enforces one observation per reference (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/typed_fact_lowering.rs:1041), matching the separate observation-reference uniqueness index (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:344).
- `LoweredCallApplicabilityObligation` carries argument slots, eligible rules and an applicability reason (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/typed_fact_lowering.rs:570); the new `call_obligations` family gives the reason semantic columns and stores the two collections in JSONB-checked columns (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:145).
- `BindingNodeKind` has ten variants, including semantic-bearing symbols/endpoints and a node-bearing `JumpToScope` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/model.rs:527); the new node table distinguishes ten kind values and separates semantic and target-node payload columns (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:169).
- The new path schema interpolates `BindingNodeId::universal_root().get()` into root predicates (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:167); that constructor uses the reserved identity domain with boundary key zero (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/model.rs:437). Persistent path rows instead represent the universal root as `-1` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_draft_schema.sql:107).
- `LoweredSemanticSite` associates a source site, namespace, role, semantic and node (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_lowering.rs:324); the new semantics table has corresponding columns plus producer sequence and source metadata (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:237).
- `PreparedResolutionCapsule` retains declaration presentations and reference contexts (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_publication.rs:163); their ranges, occurrence/module coordinates and owner variants are defined at crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_publication.rs:137. The new declaration and reference-context tables expose those fields as columns (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:255).
- `LoweredCoverageGap` carries gap identity, reason semantic, site, origin and frontier (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/resolution/fact_lowering.rs:270); the new gaps table exposes these dimensions and indexes subject, endpoint and reason independently (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/resolution_stage/rows.rs:283).

text: - [P2] Follow alias chains before extracting wrapper arguments — src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:7346-7347 — For `using Ptr = Wrapper<Node>; using Alias = Ptr;`, the receiver's alias is `Alias`, so this reads `Ptr` as the wrapper head and collects no arguments. Resolving the head follows the alias to `Wrapper`, but its `T` cannot be substituted and `Alias::operator->` member resolution fails; the template arguments need to be retained while following the alias chain.
brief_text:
## Affected callers
- `resolve_cpp_field` obtains receiver owners and passes them to member lookup (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:5727`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:5737`); identifier owners now pass the lookup context into `cpp_receiver_unit_for_access` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6331`).
- `cpp_field_expression_type` also obtains receiver owners, then restricts member candidates to fields and reads their declared types (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6266`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6283`); this shares the changed receiver conversion (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6349`).
- The new arrow lookup calls `cpp_member_candidates` with both call filters set to `None` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:7357`); that shared helper searches direct members before inherited members, sorts, and deduplicates candidates (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:5872`).
- `cpp_call_return_type` selects the first candidate yielding a type through `cpp_function_return_type` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:7554`), which now delegates return text extraction to `cpp_function_return_type_text` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:7563`). Its candidate sources are qualified class members and visible free functions (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:7528`).

## Paths
- `resolve_cpp` dispatches calls and field references separately (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:5355`); member calls rejoin field resolution with argument count and inferred argument types (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:5590`), reaching the changed receiver conversion (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6331`).
- `cpp_field_receiver_type_units` derives the alias-unwrapping flag from the source text between receiver and member (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6411`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6442`); that flag gates the new arrow lookup (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6423`). Parenthesized and pointer-expression receivers propagate the flag to their inner receiver (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6383`).
- An arrow lookup producing `None` leaves `cpp_receiver_unit_for_access` returning `cpp_type.unit` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6425`, `src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:6429`); subsequent member lookup produces either a candidate outcome or `no_definition` with reason `unsupported_cpp_receiver` (`src/analyzer/usages/get_definition.rs:5737`).

text: - [P1] Avoid resolving every Go import with a full file scan — src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:230-232. On a large Go repository, the first reverse lookup now calls `imported_code_units_of` for every file, and that resolver scans all analyzed files for each import. This makes even a single lookup quadratic in repository size, whereas the previous lookup first filtered candidates by the requested target and only performed that expensive resolution for matching importers. The new index can therefore make the cold lookup substantially slower or cause timeouts on the large repositories this change targets.
brief_text:
## Affected callers
- Python has a separate `build_reverse_import_index` that resolves bindings, populates its forward cache, and groups importers by target source (`src/analyzer/python_analyzer.rs:224`); it does not call the new shared builder (`src/analyzer/capabilities.rs:64`).
- `MultiAnalyzer::referencing_files_of` calls every delegate's import provider and unions their results, without selecting by the queried file's extension (`src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:171`); these calls reach the indexed implementations in Go (`src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:230`), JavaScript (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:226`), Rust (`src/analyzer/rust_analyzer.rs:224`), and TypeScript (`src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:240`).
- `referencing_files_for` expects an owned `BTreeSet<ProjectFile>` and stores a clone in its per-graph cache (`src/relevance.rs:437`); JavaScript's indexed lookup supplies that set (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:231`). Graph expansion records each returned importer in both adjacency maps and queues newly encountered files (`src/relevance.rs:354`).
- The capability re-export retains `referencing_files_via_imports` alongside the new builder (`src/analyzer/mod.rs:26`); Java still calls that helper before adding references inferred from identifiers within the same package (`src/analyzer/java_analyzer.rs:270`).

## Paths
- The CLI passes the workspace analyzer to `most_relevant_files` (`src/bin/most_relevant_files.rs:81`), which calls the relevance scorer (`src/searchtools.rs:477`). Its import phase builds a graph (`src/relevance.rs:159`) and requests reverse neighbors (`src/relevance.rs:343`), reaching the shared index builder through language providers (`src/analyzer/capabilities.rs:64`). Git results can fill the requested limit before the import phase (`src/relevance.rs:89`).
- `MultiAnalyzer::update` dispatches to delegate updates (`src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:256`), including Go (`src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:105`). Go creates an empty reverse-index lock alongside replacement forward and reverse caches (`src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:318`), even when the inner tree-sitter update returns its clone for an empty change set (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:648`).
- JavaScript's `update` and `update_all` allocate new `JsMemoCaches` (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:295`, `src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:303`); their existing constructor calls now also initialize an empty reverse-index lock (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:129`).
- The delegate's Rust `update_all` route (`src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:125`) rebuilds the inner analyzer (`src/analyzer/rust_analyzer.rs:291`) and creates an empty reverse-index lock (`src/analyzer/rust_analyzer.rs:295`); the inner rebuild enumerates project state anew (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:682`).
- TypeScript checks its per-target reverse cache before initializing the index (`src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:236`, `src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:240`). Its `update` and `update_all` routes replace that index (`src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:317`, `src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:327`), reached through delegate dispatch (`src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:109`, `src/analyzer/multi_analyzer.rs:124`).

## Value flow
- The shared builder receives each analyzer's `get_analyzed_files()` set (`src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:231`); the underlying implementation collects keys from `state.files` (`src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:639`). The builder invokes forward resolution for every member using parallel iteration (`src/analyzer/capabilities.rs:71`).
- Reverse-index keys come from `CodeUnit::source()`, which returns the unit's stored `ProjectFile` (`src/analyzer/model.rs:207`); the builder groups importing files under those keys, excludes self references, and deduplicates importers with a `BTreeSet` (`src/analyzer/capabilities.rs:79`).
- Go derives `Clone` (`src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:109`), so cloned analyzers share the new `Arc<OnceLock<...>>` (`src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:115`). JavaScript also derives `Clone` and stores memo caches behind an `Arc` (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:107`), sharing the lock added inside those caches (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:119`).
- Go's builder callback (`src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:232`) reads the forward cache or resolves imports against analyzed file parents (`src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:185`). Resolution skips `_` aliases and includes non-module top-level declarations from matching files (`src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:193`, `src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:210`).
- JavaScript's index callback (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:228`) consumes forward results from `imported_code_units_of` (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:165`); its path resolver accepts relative module paths and probes direct files and directory index files (`src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:1084`, `src/analyzer/javascript_analyzer.rs:1128`).
- Rust's index callback (`src/analyzer/rust_analyzer.rs:226`) consumes cached units or units found by fully qualified import names (`src/analyzer/rust_analyzer.rs:199`). Name resolution translates `crate`, `super`, and `self` paths into dotted names before declaration lookup (`src/analyzer/rust_analyzer.rs:907`).
- TypeScript's callback (`src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:242`) consumes its forward resolver's units (`src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:180`): wildcard imports select non-module declarations; named imports match identifiers, then use module or single-declaration fallback (`src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:191`, `src/analyzer/typescript_analyzer.rs:208`).

verification.summary: The claimed newly quadratic Go cold lookup already occurred through the old filter's full-resolution fallback.
verification.evidence: At intro, src/analyzer/go_analyzer.rs:270-287 shows could_import_file falling back to imported_code_units_of(source_file) whenever the requested target does not match an import path. This fallback is unchanged from base 5cfbe06f0104331f1899b2a8a666865eb432d62f, go_analyzer.rs:259-276. The old referencing_files_via_imports helper (src/analyzer/capabilities.rs:49-59) called that predicate for every candidate, then resolved matching candidates too. Thus nonmatching importers were not cheaply filtered out: a cold lookup already reached the all_files scan (intro go_analyzer.rs:190-207) for essentially every candidate. The new eager index does not introduce the claimed asymptotic regression.

text: - [P2] Include pointer depth in field type agreement — crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8049-8053. When candidate fields have the same underlying class but different pointer depths, such as `T value` and `T* value` inherited from different bases, this comparison treats their types as equal and returns whichever declaration appears first. The resulting `CppType` retains that arbitrary indirection, so it can select an incorrect overload when the field expression is used as a call argument, and it also defeats the intended fail-closed handling of conflicting declarations.
brief_text:

- `cpp_expression_type` routes field expressions to `cpp_field_expression_type` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:7791), whose field candidates now pass through `cpp_unanimous_field_type` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:7873); these expression types also become call argument types through `cpp_call_argument_types` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:7749).
- `resolve_cpp_call` passes the function expression directly to `cpp_receiver_type_units` for explicit operator calls (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:5090), reaching the same qualified and subscript receiver arms used for member access (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:7993).
- `cpp_call_return_type` supplies `seeded_bindings` to receiver typing before selecting member candidates (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:10163); the subscript arm forwards those bindings to its argument (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8018), and the resulting candidates feed unanimous return-type inference (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:10194).
- `cpp_identifier_value_type` calls `cpp_enclosing_member_field_type` only after checking precise local bindings and active shadows (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8077); enclosing field candidates now use unanimous typing (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8644).
- The inverse scanner's `declaring_owner_for_explicit_receiver` (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:8450) and `receiver_has_known_non_target` (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:8756) both consume receiver units from the walk whose qualified-name arm now calls `qualified_receiver_base` (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:7898).

## Paths
- `resolve_cpp` dispatches call and field references separately (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:801); calls with a field-expression function converge on `resolve_cpp_field` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:5124), which reaches the changed receiver arms through `cpp_field_receiver_type_units` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:6000).
- An empty receiver result from the new qualified arm (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8009) reaches `resolve_cpp_field`: it first checks external-member evidence, then returns `unsupported_cpp_receiver` when no owner resolved; a resolved owner with no candidates produces `no_indexed_definition` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:6024).
- Enclosing-field typing submits its owner to `cpp_member_candidates` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8643); the underlying lookup searches direct members first and traverses bases when that tier is empty (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:6867).
- Inverse initializer inference supplies a receiver callback with a decremented call-depth budget (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:769); that callback reaches the shared qualified-name resolution arm (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:7898), alongside the explicit-receiver navigation route.

## Value flow
- The new qualified-variable arm sends its agreed `CppType` to `cpp_receiver_unit_for_access` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:7998); that helper uses an alias arrow target when requested and available, otherwise the type's unit (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8175). The request flag comes from the enclosing field expression's arrow-access detection (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8164).
- `cpp_unanimous_field_type` obtains types through `cpp_field_declared_type` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8040); that constructor reads normalized type text, a resolved unit and indirection from the shared declared-field fact resolver (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/resolver.rs:10833), adds an alias unit and sets `pointee_const` to false (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:7891).
- Both the type agreement check (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/cpp.rs:8051) and qualified-variable identity check (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:7764) use `same_visible_symbol` (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/resolver.rs:15056); its logical-symbol branch compares kind, fully qualified name and signature without comparing source files (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/resolver.rs:15121).
- `qualified_receiver_base` collects `GlobalField` candidates (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:7753) through `named_candidates`, which normalizes the reference and clones matched units (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/resolver.rs:7158); its identity filter accepts fields whose persisted short name contains no dot (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:7425).
- With no retained global fields, `qualified_receiver_base` returns a type lookup result (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:7759); `VisibilityIndex::resolve_type` selects the first normalized type candidate (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/resolver.rs:4772). Variable results instead enter the inverse's `receiver_units_from_declared_fields` (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:7900), which resolves each declaration and reduces the units to one visible symbol (crates/bifrost-cpp/src/graph/extractor.rs:8318).
